steps.desc: Start with the first bracket. The 5 outside multiplies every term inside it, so take those terms one at a time.
Multiply the 5 by the first term inside the first bracket.
Multiply the 5 by the second term, keeping the minus sign that belongs to the 3.
So the first bracket expands to the sum of those two products.
Now the second bracket. The 2 outside multiplies both terms inside it in exactly the same way.
Multiply the 2 by the first term inside the second bracket.
Multiply the 2 by the second term inside the second bracket.
Write both expanded brackets out in full, keeping every sign as it stands.
Collect the like terms: the $x$ terms together, then the constants together.
